tagline: A warm, practical path into tech—built together.

hero.headline: Practical learning, delivered in chapters.
hero.subheadline: Open Tech Community runs guided cohorts and mentorship to help participants build real projects, strengthen fundamentals, and progress with support.

homeSections.title: Our story
homeSections.lead: It started as a small circle of builders sharing notes, wins, and blockers.
body: We kept noticing the same thing: talented people were leaving the path because it felt lonely and confusing.
So we designed a community where learning happens in public—kindly, steadily, with real projects and real support.

homeSections.title: What we build together
homeSections.lead: Programs, mentorship, and a culture of shipping.
body: We run guided cohorts that feel like chapters—each with a clear start, a steady rhythm, and a satisfying finish.
Mentors don’t just teach; they co-navigate with you. The goal is momentum you can keep.

homeSections.title: The road ahead
homeSections.lead: The next chapters are already forming.
body: Upcoming programs focus on practical, modern skills and learning-by-building.
Pick a chapter that fits your season, and we’ll meet you there.

homeSections.title: How it works
homeSections.lead: A steady cadence that makes progress feel normal.
body: Each program follows a simple rhythm: learn a concept, build a small piece, then reflect and iterate.
We keep scope honest so you can finish with pride—and repeat the pattern on your own.

homeSections.title: Community norms
body: We ask questions early, we share blockers without shame, and we give feedback that helps people move forward.
We value clarity over cleverness—and we build a culture where beginners can stay.
